description: Analyze a fintech company's financials, risk profile, and regulatory history by stock ticker (e.g., "AAPL"). Returns SEC filings, income statements, stock quotes, consumer complaints, and company overview.

_avKey.description: Alpha Vantage API key (optional, for stock/financial data)

_fredKey.description: FRED API key (optional, for macro context)

name: fintech_company_deep_dive

cik.description: SEC CIK lookup result or null if unavailable

company_overview.description: Company fundamentals and overview or null if unavailable

consumer_complaints.description: CFPB consumer complaints or null if unavailable

income_statement.description: Income statement financials or null if unavailable

macro_context.description: Macro economic context or null if FRED key not provided

sec_filings.description: SEC 10-K filings data or null if unavailable

stock_quote.description: Current stock quote data or null if unavailable

title: Fintech Company Deep Dive
